spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Yeni endpoint POST /api/v1/templates/catalog/bulk (superadmin-only). Body: TemplateBulkCreateRequest { templates: TemplateCreateRequest[] }. Response: TemplateBulkCreateResult { succeeded: TemplateCatalogDto[], failed: { index, slug, error_code, error_message }[] }. Per-item try/catch — atomic degil, partial success kabul.
